name: composer
summary: The box a person writes a message in, with a Send button.

properties.name: label
properties.description: What the box is for, spoken: "Message Mia". Required, because the placeholder is not a label.

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: An example of what to write, shown while the box is empty.

properties.name: sendLabel
properties.description: The Send button's name, for other languages.

properties.name: sendOn
properties.description: Which key sends: enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a new line; modenter sends on Ctrl+Enter and Enter starts a new line.

properties.name: sending
properties.description: The message is on its way: the button shows a spinner and nothing more sends. "Sending" is announced when it turns on.

properties.name: sendDisabledReason
properties.description: Sending is off, and why. The person can still write; Send is disabled and the reason shows under the box and is read with it.

properties.name: maxRows
properties.description: Lines the box grows to before it scrolls.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Disables the box and the Send button.

events.name: send
events.description: The person sent; carries the text. The host clears the box.

states.name: rest
states.description: The box in one frame with the Send button at its trailing end.

states.name: focused
states.description: One focus ring around the whole frame.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Faded; neither the box nor Send responds. With a reason, only Send is off.

states.name: busy
states.description: Sending: Send shows a spinner and is off.

accessibility.name: The box is named by its label; Send by its sendLabel, which it keeps while sending; "Sending" is announced once when sending turns on. A reason is read with the box.
accessibility.keyboard: Tab reaches the box, then Send. Enter sends, or Ctrl+Enter with sendOn modenter; an input method composing a word is never cut off.
accessibility.web: A <textarea> named by its label with aria-describedby for the reason, and a Send <button>.
accessibility.apple: A text field with the label, and a Send button, in one group.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Edit with the Value pattern, named by its label, and a ControlType.Button named by its send label; help text is the reason.
accessibility.android: An editable-text node named by its label with the reason as its state description, and a Send button with a click action that is disabled while sending or off.

cases.person: An empty box with "Write a message" in it and a Send button at its end.

props.label: Reply in thread
props.sendDisabledReason: You're offline. Sending resumes when you reconnect.

cases.person: A box you can write in, a faded Send button, and the reason under it.

children.name: You're offline. Sending resumes when you reconnect.

cases.person: A Send button showing a spinner.

deviations: Web also takes actions, a toolbar, attachments, a quote, highlights and an expanded mode; native kits start with the box and Send, and take those as later slots.
Web's sendOn is "enter" or "mod-enter"; the spec writes it "modenter", because enum values are lowercase letters and digits.

windows.type: Ouro.UI.Windows.OuroComposer, a templated WinUI Control; not yet built

android.type: bot.ouro.ui.hx.OuroComposer, in Jetpack Compose (ourostack/ouro-ui-android); not yet built
